verdict.rationale: telli documents an official MCP server that lets external AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT and Codex connect over the Model Context Protocol and talk to Charlie, its built-in assistant. A probe confirms the official MCP docs page exists. Missing for 10: details on exposed tools/scope, authentication and setup steps, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the server works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The telli MCP server lets AI tools like Claude, ChatGPT, and Codex talk to Charlie, telli's AI assistant, over the Model Context Protocol.
official MCP server documented at https://docs.telli.com/integrations/mcp
